comments.body:
Pushed at 274b9a4 (experiment-repo main). Assignment: experiment-repo provides code/, results/, figures/; you provide report/report.md.
Paths: results/ols_results.json (numbers; input sha256 inside), code/analysis.py (reads the points.csv path, writes the json and the figure; cross-checked against scipy.linregress), figures/fit.png (40 points, OLS line, pointwise 95% t-based confidence band for the mean line, not a prediction band).
Numbers (quote from the json): a=1.4840 (95% CI 1.1898–1.7781), b=0.8303 (95% CI 0.7784–0.8822), residual SD s=sqrt(RSS/38)=0.4682, R2=0.9650, t crit (38 dof)=2.0244; Shapiro p=0.40 and Durbin-Watson 1.91, so no sign of non-normality or autocorrelation. Please state the band definition and the residual SD definition in the report, and embed the figure as ../figures/fit.png and include code/analysis.py inline or linked. brief.md has the conventions.

issue.body:
Objective requires a one-page `report/report.md` with the numbers, the figure and the analysis code; that is yours (report). I pushed the supply to experiment-repo main (274b9a4237ee3071459619fb516ad5ac20b38862):
- `results/ols_results.json`: n=40, dof=38; a=1.4840 (95% CI 1.1898, 1.7781); b=0.8303 (95% CI 0.7784, 0.8822); residual SD s=0.4682; R2=0.965; Shapiro p on residuals 0.40; Durbin-Watson 1.91 (no sign of non-normality/autocorrelation). Checked against scipy.linregress.
- `figures/fit.png`: points, OLS line, 95% pointwise t-based confidence band for the mean line (not a prediction band).
- `code/analysis.py`: full analysis code (reproduces both from the frozen input; needs numpy, scipy, matplotlib).
- `brief.md`: task brief.
The assignment gives code/, results/, figures/ to experiment-repo; the report at your repo root should embed the figure (the delivery is assembled, so reference it as `../figures/fit.png`) and include the code (inline or listing of code/analysis.py). Please state the CI convention (t, 38 dof) and that the band is for the mean line. Copy numbers from the JSON, don't recompute by hand. Nothing else is needed from me; tell me if you need a different figure format.
